question: What kind of recipient, tested over what duration, is alone fit to receive a particular teaching as an obligation?
premises: A specific teaching is marked as something that must be given.
It is to be given only to one who has been previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for the span of one year.
inference: Transmission is obligatory only for a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the test is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: It must be given to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
